data.name: Reflections of Life: Gone But Not Forgotten Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Grandma Studios proudly presents the latest spine-tingling adventure in the Reflections of Life series!

The city of Harmoris is under siege! Each night, creatures emerge from the darkness bent on destruction! Residents hide in their homes as the skeletal hands of an unknown master prowl the streets. Their only hope of salvation is the Order of the Guardians. It’s up to you and your trusted owl companion to uncover the truth! Can you stop the invisible villain spreading terror throughout Harmoris before the city completely falls to darkness? Find out in this riveting Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Experience Veliar's apprenticeship as he becomes entangled in the necromancer's dark quest for the Sphere of Oblivion!

  • Play and re-play Mini-Games and HOPs, earn Achievements, and collect all the hidden Owls!

  • Unlock the secret HOP and solve the bonus Jigsaw Puzzle!

  • Enjoy unique wallpapers, concept art, music, movies, and more!

  • With the helpful Strategy Guide, you can navigate Harmoris and steer clear of the undead!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game - a sub genre of point & click adventure. Follow protagonists on a story-driven quest, find cleverly hidden objects, and solve various puzzles to advance the plot.
